question: How many customers are there?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: How many products do we sell?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products

question: How many orders have been placed?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: How many customers are from the United Kingdom?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'United Kingdom'

question: List the names of customers from Canada.
SQL: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country = 'Canada'

question: List the product names in the Books category.
SQL: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Books'

question: Which products cost more than 25? Return their names.
SQL: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > 25

question: What is the average product price?
SQL: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products

question: What is the price of the cheapest product?
SQL: SELECT MIN(price) FROM products

question: What is the name of the most expensive product?
SQL: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total revenue across all orders?
SQL: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id

question: What is our average order value?
evidence: average order value = total revenue divided by number of orders; revenue = quantity times price
SQL: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id

question: Show revenue by product category, highest first.
SQL: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS rev FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY rev DESC

question: What is our best-selling product?
SQL: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which product generated the most revenue?
SQL: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customer has placed the most orders? Return their name.
SQL: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customer generated the most revenue? Return their name.
SQL: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show each customer's total revenue, highest first.
evidence: revenue = quantity times product price; customers without orders are excluded
SQL: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS rev FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY rev DESC

question: How many orders did Alice place?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Alice'

question: Which products did Bob order? Return the product names.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE c.name = 'Bob'

question: Which customers have not placed any orders? Return their names.
SQL: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

question: Which product categories had no orders in January 2026?
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products WHERE category NOT IN (SELECT p.category FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_date LIKE '2026-01%')

question: Which customers from the United Kingdom did not place an order in January 2026? Return their names.
SQL: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country = 'United Kingdom' AND id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2026-01%')

question: How many orders were placed in February 2026?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2026-02%'

question: What was the total revenue in February 2026?
SQL: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_date LIKE '2026-02%'

question: On what date did Alice place her first order?
SQL: SELECT MIN(o.order_date) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Alice'

question: What is the date of the most recent order?
SQL: SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM orders

question: Who are our top 2 customers? Return their names.
evidence: top customers = highest total revenue; revenue = quantity times product price
SQL: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) DESC LIMIT 2

question: What is our most popular product?
SQL: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which country is our biggest market?
evidence: biggest market = country with the highest total revenue; revenue = quantity times product price
SQL: SELECT c.country FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many units of Electronics products have been sold in total?
SQL: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics'

question: How many distinct products has Alice ordered?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE c.name = 'Alice'

question: What is the average number of units per order?
evidence: units = sum of item quantities in the order
SQL: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) FROM order_items oi

question: Which customers bought 'The Pragmatic Programmer'? Return their names.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'The Pragmatic Programmer'

question: How many units of the 'USB-C Cable' were sold?
SQL: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'USB-C Cable'

question: What was the revenue from the Books category?
SQL: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Books'

question: How many different countries do our customers come from?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) FROM customers

question: Show every customer and how many orders they placed, including customers with none.
SQL: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id

question: How many units have been sold across all orders?
SQL: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items

question: Which customers placed more than one order? Return their names.
SQL: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
